locText: Decide when families can visit and how each booking window works. Availability Booking experience Preview & Share Families booking at South Campus see the times from 1 schedule set here plus 4 organization-wide schedules. Each time is offered once, even if two schedules cover it, and bookings at that time share its capacity. Organization-wide schedules apply at every location and are changed in Organization › Tours. To give South Campus different times only, add a schedule here; to stop offering an organization-wide time here, it has to change for every location.
